USA.other_barrier: Section 232 semiconductor Phase 2 could reach laptops (proposed 25%, not enacted as of Oct 2026); Phase 1 covers only 8471.50/.80 servers with qualifying chips
USA.note: MFN free on HTS 8471.30. Laptops (8471.30-.90) exempt from the 60-economy Section 301 action of 24 Jul 2026 (10% ID/MY, 12.5% VN). China's 2019 List 4B (laptops) stays suspended; one commercial tracker lists 25% - conflicting. IEEPA tariffs struck down 20 Feb 2026; Section 122 surcharge expired 24 Jul 2026

EU.note: Zero duty on laptops (CN 8471 30 00) under the WTO Information Technology Agreement, every origin

GBR.note: Zero duty on laptops under the WTO Information Technology Agreement, every origin

AUS.other_barrier: GST 10% on import (recoverable, not a duty)

SGP.other_barrier: GST 9% on CIF (recoverable, not a duty)
SGP.note: Electronics are not on the dutiable list

IND.other_barrier: Import licence required (IMS authorisation, valid to 31 Dec 2026); IGST 18% on import
IND.note: 0% basic customs duty under WTO ITA; laptops are a restricted import

BRA.other_barrier: IPI 15% on top; local production under PPB / Lei de Informatica gets IPI relief (not modelled)
BRA.note: Import duty (II) 16% on NCM 8471.30.12 (Mercosur TEC, Gecex 272/2021, checked 5 Oct 2026); a Brazilian-made laptop pays no import duty

ARE.note: GCC tariff 5% of CIF on computers. A unit assembled in a UAE free zone from imported kits is still dutiable when it enters the mainland unless it qualifies as a GCC national product (local value added and ownership tests) - assumed not met. Some guides list laptops as duty-free
